The peaks at m/z 183, 184, and 185 with varying intensities could indicate the presence of elements like Bromine or Chlorine, which have significant isotopic differences. I will compare these peaks with the isotopic distribution data to identify the elements.

- Bromine has isotopes at m/z 79 and 81, which could correspond to the observed pattern.
- Chlorine has isotopes at m/z 35 and 37, which could also fit the pattern.

Given the isotopic distribution and the mass spectrometry data, Bromine is a likely candidate due to the close intensity ratios observed in the spectrum.
